turnaround_reason: World's largest store-brand OTC drug maker at 10-year lows (~$10.24 vs 52w high $27.16) after infant-formula exit, a slow Opill ramp, a $3.83B debt load, and a CEO fired for personal misconduct. Forward P/E ~4.5x and 0.57x book with a leaner Consumer Self-Care refocus, Dermacosmetics divestiture proceeds cutting debt, and reaffirmed FY26 guidance suggest the equity is priced for a disaster the fundamentals don't yet show.
bullish_points: Q2 2026 earnings Aug 5 (interim CEO Manzone + CFO Bezerra) is a hard binary catalyst against 25.5% short-of-float and 5.5 short ratio — a non-disaster print can trigger a squeeze
FY26 guidance reaffirmed: All-In adj EPS $2.00-$2.30 => forward P/E ~4.5-5x; last quarter beat +40% (0.43 vs 0.31 est)
Dermacosmetics sale closed post-quarter: EUR305.6M upfront (up to EUR332.6M) earmarked for debt reduction — concrete deleveraging
All 4 covering analysts rate buy, mean target $16.50 (range $14-$20) = ~60% upside; P/B 0.57x, EV/EBITDA 7.7x
Positive FCF ($108M) and operating cash flow ($189M) service the debt even in a soft year; current ratio 2.7
bearish_points: $3.83B total debt vs $1.42B market cap (D/E 153) makes the equity a subordinated call option — any EBITDA slip erases it
Revenue declining -7.2% TTM (organic was ~-11% in Q1); this is a shrinking top line, not a stabilizing one
Profit margin -43.5% TTM reflects heavy impairments; GAAP profitability not yet restored
CEO resignation for misconduct leaves an interim leader and an open permanent search — governance overhang
Dossier news feed returned all-null; catalyst read is from external search, not the dossier itself
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings print + guidance/deleveraging update; short-covering squeeze if the quarter clears the lowball bar
suggested_trade: Small spot starter ($10.00-$11.00 entry) sized at ~50% of a normal position; treat as an event-driven option into the Aug 5 print, not a core value hold. Options exist but OI is thin (~1.5k calls) and ATM IV is low (~12.5%) — spot preferred.
key_risk: Q2 shows continued organic revenue decline and/or a guidance cut, confirming the debt-load bear case and removing squeeze fuel
would_skip_if: You want a clean balance sheet or confirmed revenue growth — this is a levered, event-driven turnaround spec, not a low-risk compounder
